title: Add Notion database rows with AI from your approved notes
h1: turn a clear request into a notion database row
description: Turn an approved decision into a Notion database row with matching columns and a short page body. See how to keep missing fields and duplicate rows out.
keyword: notion add database row with ai
keywords: ai turn notes into notion rows
answer: **get the approved purchase out of your notes and into the tracker.** a bot adds a notion database row with table properties and a short page body. missing fields can stay empty. share the database with the connection first, and use a database with one data source. put any approval step in the request.

review.by: lead agent, after two independent reviewer passes, against Metal docs and the composio catalog

og_line: your notes, in the right database fields.
what:
**put the headline in the table and the detail inside the row.** properties fill the columns; content blocks hold the longer note. paste the database link and have the bot read its columns first.

keep entries short. long text can lose its ending, and extra blocks arrive after the page exists. open the body to see the whole note. this inserts a new row rather than updating an old one.
uses: record a confirmed equipment purchase in your purchasing database
add an accepted research proposal with its short brief inside
log a workshop booking after the date and organiser agree
save an idea with its source and leave undecided fields empty

routine.message: every thursday at 12:35, read new approval files added this week to the 'approved purchases' google drive folder for thistledown theatre. look for existing entries in the linked notion purchasing database. show proposed rows here with the source file and matching columns. ask me before you change anything. create only the rows i confirm, with short source notes. never guess costs or update old rows. if an insert result is uncertain, look for the row before trying again.
routine.needs: google drive read only; notion read and write; a single-source database shared with the connection
routine.output:
thistledown theatre purchase preview
item: portable lectern
source: approved purchases / lectern-approval.pdf
cost: missing, left empty
confirm this preview to create the row.

steps: connect notion and share the intended database with the connection
allow **read and write**, limited to inspection and insertion
match one short entry to the actual columns before inserting
open the saved row and its body; pause if anything went missing
watch: **choose a database with one data source.** this action cannot insert into a multi-source database.
**a row can exist before its whole body arrives.** inspect long notes and extra blocks.
**inserts do not ask first by default.** put the review instruction in your message.

faq.q: is a database row different from a notion page?
faq.a: **the row is a page inside the database.** its properties fill the table. its content blocks form the page body.

faq.q: will it replace a row with the same title?
faq.a: **each insert adds a fresh row.** look for an existing entry before retrying an uncertain result, even when the title is the same.

steps: share one notion database with the connection
ask the bot to read its columns
preview one short row with missing fields empty
confirm, then inspect the row and body

mistakes.mistake: retrying because the body looks unfinished
mistakes.fix: look for the row first. its body can still be arriving.

mistakes.mistake: feeding the routine approvals buried in chat
mistakes.fix: point it at new approval files in a connected folder.

tip.text: an empty cost is more useful than a confident guess.
